observable_outcome: The M2 local closure is provable without touching Google Cloud: the Firestore hard budget is 50 percent of the free daily allowance and is enforced before any mutation is staged while still leaving the plane usable, a stored-bytes ceiling exists, budget exhaustion surfaces as an explicit 429 quota_exhausted instead of a 400, the deployment preflight contract exists with fixtures and a ledger test that refuses live evidence without a prior human approval, the OpenTofu module still validates and the drift and plan scripts fail closed, the deploy workflow can actually start and can only apply the plan a human approved, and devbox run --pure -- make check is green at the committed checkpoint with the V2-013 evidence registered in .agents/v2/evidence/index.json.
acceptance_criteria: A1. internal/quota enforces the 50 percent hard budget from dp-v2-012 d2: DefaultBudget becomes 25,000 reads, 10,000 writes and 10,000 deletes per UTC day, and a new stored-bytes level, separate from the daily counter and not reset at midnight, enforces 268,435,456 payload bytes against a 536,870,912-byte total allowance. Unit tests assert each ceiling fails closed exactly one operation over the line, that the daily counter resets on a UTC day change while the stored-bytes level does not, and that a negative or zero-valued reservation is rejected.

A2. The reservation is still made before any mutation is staged, and the staged quota delta is trued up to the actual operation count before the transaction flushes, using the documents actually read in the unit-of-work cache and the writes and deletes actually staged. Tests prove all three properties: an over-budget worst case is refused before a single document is staged, a transaction that reads far fewer documents than the worst case commits only its actual cost, and the trued-up total never goes below zero or above the pre-checked worst case. Record the measured daily capacity before and after in the evidence summary; the pre-change measurement is 4 read transactions and 625 mutations per day at the 50 percent ceiling.

A3. quota.ErrOverBudget maps to HTTP 429 with error code quota_exhausted and a Retry-After naming the next UTC midnight, through internal/api.domainError, with a test that the same request returns 429 and not 400 invalid_request. The exhaustion is surfaced as an explicit waiting or needs-input outcome for the affected work rather than as a caller error, and no budget figure in the response body reveals anything beyond the ceilings already documented.

A4. contracts/schemas/deployment-preflight.json exists exactly as specified in dp-v2-012 d5, with additionalProperties false at every level, and contracts/fixtures/valid/deployment-preflight.json and contracts/fixtures/invalid/deployment-preflight.json both exist, because TestSchemasAndFixtures fatally requires both for every schema file. The invalid fixture is invalid for exactly one reason (a missing approval object), stated in the work report. The schema text contains none of the substrings password, credential, raw_prompt or raw_provider_output, so TestSchemasRejectSensitiveFieldNames stays green.

A5. A new test in internal/contracts enforces the approval-before-side-effect invariant described in dp-v2-012 d5, and it passes in this task's end state where .agents/v2/preflight/ holds no files and the evidence index holds no gcp-live- component entry: an absent or empty preflight directory is a pass, not an error. The test must fail if a gcp-live- evidence entry exists with no matching preflight record, with no artifact_refs entry whose artifact_id is deployment-preflight and whose sha256 equals the record file digest, or with approval.approved_at not strictly earlier than the evidence observed_at. Demonstrate each of those three failures with a temporary fixture and record the before and after in the evidence, then remove the temporary fixture.

A6. .gitleaks.toml extends the single existing AND-scoped allowlist with the path .agents/v2/preflight/ so that a 64-hex plan or image digest in a preflight record is not reported, without adding a second allowlist block, without relaxing condition = AND and without touching any other rule. Prove the positive control required by docs/architecture/validation.md section 6: the same 64-hex shape committed outside both allowlisted paths is still reported, and a non-hex secret committed inside .agents/v2/preflight/ is still reported. Record the before and after counts.

A7. scripts/infra-policy.sh asserts the new budget figures as separate fail-closed checks, one per value, instead of the current single rg alternation that passes when any one branch matches, and additionally asserts the stored-bytes ceiling and the reconcile schedule default. Prove the assertions bind by temporarily changing each guarded value and confirming the script fails for that specific reason, then restore. devbox run --pure -- make infra-policy stays green.

A8. scripts/infra-drift.sh uses tofu plan -refresh-only -detailed-exitcode so that drift exits non-zero instead of being printed and ignored, and scripts/infra-plan.sh additionally writes infra/build/infra.plan.json via tofu show -json and prints its sha256 so that the digest a human approves is reproducible. Both scripts still refuse to run without an explicit TFVARS_FILE outside the repository, and neither performs any mutation.

A9. infra/versions.tf declares a partial gcs backend for OpenTofu state, infra/variables.tf and infra/terraform.tfvars.example gain no secret-bearing variable, scripts/infra-validate.sh continues to use tofu init -backend=false so the local closure needs no bucket, and scripts/infra-plan.sh and scripts/infra-drift.sh pass the bucket through an explicit -backend-config argument that fails closed when unset. var.reconcile_schedule defaults to */15 per dp-v2-012 d4. devbox run --pure -- make infra-validate reports that the configuration is valid.

A10. .gitignore ignores infra/terraform.tfvars and infra/*.tfstate* so that the file scripts/infra-plan.sh steers an operator to create inside the repository cannot be committed, and no state or tfvars file is tracked at the checkpoint.

A11. .github/workflows/deploy.yml pins jetify-com/devbox-install-action at 22b0f5500b14df4ea357ce673fbd4ced940ed6a1, the same revision ci.yml uses, replacing the non-existent 22c0f5500b14df4ea357ce673fbd4ced940ed6a1 that prevents the job from starting at all. The apply step applies the saved plan artifact produced by the plan step, after asserting that its sha256 equals the target.plan_digest of a committed preflight record whose approval is present, and fails closed on any mismatch or missing record. No other pinned revision in either workflow changes. devbox run --pure -- actionlint .github/workflows/deploy.yml is clean.

A12. scripts/workflow-pins.sh asserts that across .github/workflows the mapping from (action repository, version comment) to pinned sha is unique, and it is wired into a Makefile target that make check runs. Prove it binds by temporarily reintroducing the mistyped revision and confirming the script fails, then restore. State in the work report that actionlint alone cannot detect a revision that does not exist upstream, which is why this check exists.

A13. devbox run --pure -- make component-store-firestore passes against the Firestore emulator with integration coverage for the new quota behaviour: the reservation and the true-up commit atomically with the caller's mutation, a retried transaction callback does not double-count, and an over-budget transaction leaves no partial mutation. The work report states explicitly that emulator success is not evidence about real Firestore and that no claim in this task substitutes for V2-014.

A14. Exactly one evidence record, .agents/v2/evidence/V2-013-infra-plan.json, is created with task_id V2-013, id ev-v2-013-infra-plan, component infra-plan and result passed, holding one check per acceptance item above with the argv actually executed, and it is registered in .agents/v2/evidence/index.json with an evidence_hash equal to the sha256 of the file. devbox run --pure -- go test -count=1 ./internal/contracts is green, which is the completion definition: registered in the index and the ledger test green, not merely 'the tests passed'.

A15. After committing the evidence, devbox run --pure -- make check is green on the committed state, because gitleaks git scans committed history and an uncommitted file was never scanned. Checkpoints are pushed one at a time and the parent commit's v2 selective CI is confirmed green before the next push.

A16. No file outside allowed_paths changes. In particular nothing under .agents/v2/task-state/ or .agents/v2/packets/ is created or modified, ci/components.json is untouched so that no component evidence key is invalidated, and devbox.json and devbox.lock are untouched so that gcloud is not added to the environment.
constraints: Local closure only. Do not run tofu apply, do not run tofu init against a real backend, do not create, read or mutate any Google Cloud resource, and do not obtain or store any access token or key.
Never report emulator, fake or tofu validate success as verification of real Firestore, real IAP or a real apply; docs/operations/v2-task-dag.md G3 rejects that substitution at the M2 gate.

Do not write any task-state file. If a precondition is missing, report the exact block_reason string to Sol, who owns every task-state transition, because the coordinator edits .agents/v2/task-state/** concurrently.
Do not add gcloud or any package to devbox.json or devbox.lock: docs/policies/README.md makes a toolchain change invalidate every component evidence key.

Do not raise a budget ceiling to make a test pass, and do not weaken a fail-closed check into a warning. If the 50 percent ceiling cannot support the documented minimum daily operations even after the true-up, stop and escalate the ceiling-versus-usability tradeoff to product_orchestrator.

If the true-up requires changing the UnitOfWork port beyond internal/application, internal/store/firestore and internal/store/memory, or requires touching internal/domain, stop and escalate: that is a cross-boundary redesign, not this work order.
Do not weaken or bypass IAP, ingress or destroy protection in infra/, and do not modify infra/main.tf or infra/indexes.tf at all in this task.
Rollback of this task is a single git revert of its checkpoint commits; no external state is created, so nothing outside the repository needs undoing.
Work only inside the assigned isolated task worktree. Push checkpoints one at a time and wait for the parent commit CI to be green.
Japanese for the tracked documents; English identifiers in code, schemas and configuration.
